notes.subject: mɔgɔ ɲɛmajɔrɔw
notes.rationale: פתאי is 'the open-minded, seducible ones', not merely naive; Bambara needs a phrase

notes.subject: ערמה
notes.rationale: same root as the crocodile-subtle in Gen 3:1 — prudence here in a good sense, trickery elsewhere; hakili-ɲɛnabɔli keeps the cunning picture

notes.subject: Walasa ka … di
notes.rationale: the giving-clauses address the simple and the young as recipients, drawing the reader in

translation: Walasa ka hakili-ɲɛnabɔli di mɔgɔ ɲɛmajɔrɔw ma, ka dɔnniya ni ɲaɲɛmiiri di kɔrɔfitini ma.
